sentences.text:
THIS PETITION COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER

The petitioner has challenged the prosecution initiated against him in C.C.No.343/2019 pending trial before the XLV Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bengaluru for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 504 of IPC and Section 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.

entities.text: XLV Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bengaluru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. The parties have now compromised the matrimonial dispute and have filed a joint memo, in terms of which, the respondent No.2/de-facto complainant has agreed that the matrimonial disputes are amicably settled and that a decree of divorce was granted in MFA.No.3338/2020 and that she has received a sum of Rs.7,00,000/- towards permanent alimony.
She has no objection to quash the proceedings in C.C.No.343/2019 pending trial before the XLV Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bengaluru.

entities.text: XLV Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bengaluru
entities.label: COURT
